name: Microgrid black-start energy-reserve gate
aliases: microgrids Microgrid black-start and restoration controls
summary: Checks the declared stored-energy or fuel readiness required by the assigned restoration strategy.
description: Checks the declared stored-energy or fuel readiness required by the assigned restoration strategy. Black-start and restoration control coordinates the establishment of an electrical reference and the gradual return of assigned resources and loads. A dead system, an available starting source and a successful load restoration are distinct states.

In a microgrid recovering from a blackout, an available grid-forming source can establish the assigned island reference before compatible generation and eligible load groups are introduced under the validated restoration strategy. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Starting-source energy availability” at the input and “Restoration energy permission” at the output. Power capability is a separate requirement.
